subject: maximun, minimun and average hourly data

messages.author: 08e0141567e89420
messages.subject: maximun, minimun and average hourly data
parts:
Hi!
I'm looking the way of plotting time series, in particular daily weather measurements.
In general, I think that I will use line graphics. But for example, to represent the maximun, minimun and average hourly temperature data I would like to use something similar to price quotation graphic of Excel.
Is there any way with ggplot?

Thanks a lot

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: maximun, minimun and average hourly data
parts:
You probably want to look at geom_pointrange for this? See examples at
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_linerange.html

Ben
